name: O3b / O3b mPOWER (MEO comms)
best_known_for: Only operational MEO commercial broadband — 20 O3b satellites at 8,063 km equatorial orbit, plus next-gen O3b mPOWER series (since 2022); low-latency alternative to GEO comsats
credit: SES O3b constellation. Original O3b deployed 2013-2019; mPOWER successors launching since 2022 with software-defined beam allocation.
